note: Majority: Family Code (Družinski zakonik, DZ, Uradni list RS 15/17, as amended to 34/24), read in PISRS's consolidated text: a child is a person who has not reached 18, unless full capacity came earlier; parental care ends at majority, at 18. Capacity gained earlier (by marriage, allowed by a court from 15, or by parenthood) isn't held. Work: Employment Relationships Act (Zakon o delovnih razmerjih, ZDR-1, Uradni list RS 21/13, as amended to 70/25), Article 211: work by children under 15 is prohibited; a child under 15 may, exceptionally and for pay, take part in filming and in preparing and performing artistic, stage and other works in culture, art, sport and advertising, and from 13 may do light work up to 30 days a year in school holidays, in each case only with the labour inspector's prior permit, issued on the legal representative's request. No lower age for the permit is set in the article. Hours limits for children (six hours a day and 30 a week in holidays; two a day and 12 a week in the school year) aren't held. Service: Slovenia's compulsory military term isn't served in peace; the Ministry of Defence's paper on the amendment of the Military Duty Act (Zakon o vojaški dolžnosti, consolidated ZVojD-UPB1, Uradni list RS 108/02) says the change introduces no general military obligation and aims at voluntary service, and the law lets the National Assembly bring compulsory service back on heightened danger of attack, imminent danger of war, or a state of war or emergency. The paper is from about 2021; later bills weren't looked for. Conscription registration (nabor duty of male citizens) isn't held.

sources.title: PISRS, Družinski zakonik (DZ), consolidated text
sources.said: Po tem zakoniku je otrok oseba, ki še ni dopolnila 18 let, razen če je že prej pridobila popolno poslovno sposobnost. ... (1) Starševska skrb preneha s polnoletnostjo otroka, to je, ko dopolni 18 let, ali če otrok pridobi popolno poslovno sposobnost pred polnoletnostjo.

sources.title: PISRS, Zakon o delovnih razmerjih (ZDR-1), consolidated text
sources.said: (1) Prepovedano je delo otrok, mlajših od 15 let starosti. (2) Otrok, ki je mlajši od 15 let starosti, lahko izjemoma, proti plačilu, sodeluje pri snemanju filmov, pripravi in izvajanju umetnostnih, scenskih in drugih del s področja kulturne, umetniške, športne in oglaševalne aktivnosti. ... (4) Otrok lahko opravlja delo po drugem in tretjem odstavku tega člena po predhodnem dovoljenju inšpektorja za delo, ki ga le-ta izda na podlagi zahtevka zakonitega zastopnika.
